blocks.title: Association
blocks.text: Association is a relationship between two classes. It has two kinds: aggregation and composition.

items: Aggregation: one class (Library) contains another (Book) but does not own it; books can exist without the library.
Composition: one class (House) contains and owns another (Room); the rooms cannot exist without the house.

class Book:

class Room:
....def __init__(self, name):
........self.name = name

class House:
....def __init__(self):
........self.rooms = [Room("Living Room"), Room("Bedroom")]

blocks.prompt: Is a student and a school an aggregation or a composition?
blocks.explanation: Aggregation: the school has students, but a student exists independently of the school.

items: Association: aggregation (has, but does not own: Library and Book) and composition (owns: House and Room).
